name: Music Tribe
h1: An analyst-led company deserves connected data
lede: Music Tribe runs a flat, analyst-led model on real-time data, sells factory-direct through Super Partners and manages brands from Behringer to Midas and Tannoy. A connected layer turns that data into owned, tracked actions.
why_h2: A different operating model, at scale
why_p: Music Tribe has rebuilt how it leads, sells and shows up to the market. Each change depends on teams and partners working from the same information.

signals.title: Back at NAMM for a second year
signals.body: Music Tribe brought Behringer, TC Electronic, Aston Microphones, Midas and its other brands to The NAMM Show 2026, its second year running after a decade away.
signals.angle: Multi-brand launch calendars, assets and approvals planned in one shared workspace.

signals.title: AI-supported leadership model
signals.body: Uli Behringer replaced Music Tribe's traditional C-suite with an AI-supported, data-driven leadership model run by business and data analysts working from real-time data.
signals.angle: A connected work layer that turns real-time data into owned actions.

signals.title: RAD Distribution partnership
signals.body: Music Tribe partnered with RAD Distribution to reach more dealers in the United States.
signals.angle: Partner onboarding, programmes and performance tracked in one place rather than email threads.

signals.title: Super Partnership with Thomann
signals.body: Music Tribe and Thomann announced factory-direct shipping, joint product development and marketing, and Thomann-run service, as Music Tribe exits bricks-and-mortar retail.
signals.angle: Super Partner programmes span product, marketing and service teams; a shared plan beats inbox coordination.
